name: Blast Mine explodes on enemy contact (#4029)
contract: Deploy Blast Mine 801718 summons mine entry 50045, which previously never detonated on contact: UpdateAI had a proximity branch only for entry 226312 and Bomb() entries. A new branch explodes 50045 when a valid enemy is within 2 yards, mirroring the 226312 Nearby check.

Casting the mine near the hostile golem detonates it on contact: the mine must disappear well before its 60 s timeout, the golem must take explosion damage, and Remote Detonation 801798 must remain known.

steps.label: Let login and class synchronisation settle
Let the golem close into the mine
